name: TimeZone
description: Timezone information for the geographic location of the IP.

offset_with_dst.description:
Current UTC offset in hours, accounting for DST if active. Same as
`offset` when DST is not in effect.

current_time.description:
Current local time at the IP's location. Observed formats include
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±ZZZZ` and `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS±ZZZZ`.

current_time_unix.description: Current time as a Unix timestamp with millisecond precision.

current_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the timezone currently in effect (may be standard or DST).

current_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the timezone currently in effect.

standard_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the standard (non-DST) timezone.

is_dst.description: Whether Daylight Saving Time is currently active.

dst_savings.description:
DST offset in hours applied on top of the standard offset when DST is
active. `0` means no DST shift (either DST is not active or does not exist).

dst_exists.description: Whether this timezone observes Daylight Saving Time at all.

dst_tz_abbreviation.description: Abbreviation of the DST timezone. Empty string if DST is not observed.

dst_tz_full_name.description: Full name of the DST timezone. Empty string if DST is not observed.

dst_start.description:
Start DST transition details. When `dst_exists` is `false`, this is
returned as an empty object with no properties.

oneOf.description:
Details about a DST transition (start or end). Only present when `dst_exists`
is `true`. When `dst_exists` is `false`, `dst_start` and `dst_end` are
returned as empty objects with no properties.

utc_time.description: UTC time of the transition, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD TIME HH:mm`.

duration.description:
Clock shift direction and amount (e.g. `+1.00H` for spring forward,
`-1.00H` for fall back).

gap.description:
Whether this transition creates a gap in local time (clocks jump forward).
`true` for DST start, `false` for DST end.

date_time_after.description: Local time immediately after the transition.

date_time_before.description: Local time immediately before the transition.

overlap.description:
Whether this transition creates an overlap in local time (clocks fall back,
so the same local time occurs twice). `true` for DST end, `false` for DST
start.

dst_end.description:
End DST transition details. When `dst_exists` is `false`, this is
returned as an empty object with no properties.

oneOf.description:
Details about a DST transition (start or end). Only present when `dst_exists`
is `true`. When `dst_exists` is `false`, `dst_start` and `dst_end` are
returned as empty objects with no properties.
